result.brief: 提出免训练、可解释的生成中语义纠错框架，将 MLLM 反馈注入扩散采样循环，通过语义评估监督器与潜轨迹干预修正语义漂移，提升文本-视频对齐、保真度与时序一致性。
result.reason: Training-free MLLM-guided mid-generation correction inside the diffusion sampling loop directly targets controllable text-to-video generation and semantic alignment, matching video generation interests.
